answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The marble graph is validated at intake and the kernel frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and tundra anchors the chain at a checkpoint. An attacker who wants 14 percent of the vote must hold 8 percent of the bonded float for 56 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
